items.question: Which flowers receive special emphasis as offerings to the goddess?
premises: The japā flower is included in the enumerated offerings.
Red flowers are named alongside the japā flower.
The term viśeṣataḥ marks red flowers as especially emphasized.
items.inference: Red flowers, including the japā flower, are given special prominence among offerings to the goddess.
uncertainties: Whether rakta-puṣpam refers to red flowers in general or specifies the japā flower again is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: And the japā flower, O Goddess, and red flowers especially.
